title: Descent and order support of the coefficient derivative ideal
statement:
Let k be a characteristic-zero field, U smooth affine finite type over k, and j:N->U a closed immersion with N smooth over k [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Give U etale coordinates (w,z) over k and N their restricted etale w coordinates [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let der and derW be regular coordinate derivations killing k and taking the prescribed coordinate Kronecker values. Let the kernel of j^*:Gamma(U)->Gamma(N) be generated by n equations whose transverse der-Jacobian is a unit after evaluation at every point of N. Give centered Taylor maps TN_b, and straight_b maps on U with scalar and residue values at j(b), and coordinate formulas straight(w_l)=w_l(b)+W_l, straight(z_l)=rename(TN_b(j^*z_l))+Z_l [def-trf-regular-hilbert-coefficient-datum]. Fix b0 in N, finite weights alpha_i in N^n and arbitrary regular coefficients c_{i,gamma} on N [def-trf-supported-homogeneous-division] [def-weil-residue-field]. Put
C=(derW^delta(c_{i,gamma}):|gamma|<|alpha_i|, |delta|<|alpha_i|-|gamma|),
I=(j^*)^{-1}(C).
Assume b0 satisfies germ_b0(c_{i,gamma}) in m_b0^{|alpha_i|-|gamma|} for every |gamma|<|alpha_i|. Let J be any ideal of Gamma(U), and assume
map(straight_b0)(J)=(Z)+ (rename(partial_W^delta TN_b0(c_{i,gamma})):|gamma|<|alpha_i|, |delta|<|alpha_i|-|gamma|).
Here the regular and formal iterated derivatives use [def-trf-formal-power-series-partial-derivative], and the ideals and Taylor extensions use [def-trf-taylor-rank-minor-ideals] and [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. There is one open V containing j(b0) such that ofIdealTop(J) restricted to V equals ofIdealTop(I) restricted to V, and, for all y in V,
J<=ker(ev_y) iff there exists b in N with j(b)=y and germ_b(c_{i,gamma}) in m_b^{|alpha_i|-|gamma|} for every |gamma|<|alpha_i|.
The maximal ideal is that of the actual stalk, including at nonclosed b. No Hilbert-function or standard-basis hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: BM 1997 Theorem 7.14, Remarks 9.1 and 9.5, completion of Theorem 9.6, pp.265--268,275--277,282. Returned step 11. ILO VIII 2.3.11--2.3.13 is the route reference; BM is read online, absent locally. No single Stacks tag states this result.

proof.text: There are finitely many derivative indices because gamma and delta have bounded degree in finitely many variables. Their regular derivatives generate the ideal C. U is affine finite type over k, hence Noetherian; N is closed affine. Thus I and J define coherent ideal sheaves. Coordinate derivations commute with Taylor expansion by [lem-trf-etale-coordinate-derivations-jacobian]. Apply [lem-trf-implicit-taylor-coordinate-calculus] on the Jacobian open to identify setting Z=0 with restriction to N, and the extended equations with (Z). The extension of the inverse-image ideal I is therefore the stated formal coefficient-derivative ideal. This also follows by lifting the finite generators through the surjective affine restriction map.

The straight map, localized at j(b0), is the faithfully flat Taylor map followed by the straightening automorphism, by [lem-trf-implicit-taylor-coordinate-calculus]. Contract the assumed equality of ideal extensions to the stalk, then apply its coherent ideal neighbourhood clause to obtain ofIdealTop(J)=ofIdealTop(I) on one open V.

At each b, the normal-cone comparison [lem-trf-taylor-normal-cone-splitting] makes a germ belong to m_b^h exactly when its Taylor series has no terms of degree below h: a nonzero lowest class in m_b^r/m_b^{r+1}, r<h, has nonzero image under substitution of the independent linear Taylor forms. By [lem-trf-etale-coordinate-derivations-jacobian], the Taylor coefficient is the evaluated regular derivative divided by its factorial. Since factorials are units, vanishing of C at b is exactly the displayed list of maximal-ideal-power conditions. On affine spectra the zero locus of (j^*)^{-1}(C) is the image of the zero locus of C under the closed immersion, since j^* is surjective. Restrict to V and use the ideal-sheaf equality to replace I by J. Empty derivative lists and empty coordinate sets give the same argument with C=0.

theorem coefficient_derivative_ideal_descent
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    (U N : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine U]
    (p : U ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (j : N ⟶ U) [IsClosedImmersion j] [Smooth (j ≫ p)]
    (b₀ : N) {m n s : ℕ}
    (coord : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) k →+* Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hetale : Etale (U.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom coord)))
    (hover : U.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coord.comp MvPolynomial.C)) = p)
    (w : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k →+* Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hw : w = j.appTop.hom.comp (coord.comp (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl).toRingHom))
    (hetaleW : Etale (N.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w)))
    (der : (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) → Derivation ℤ Γ(U, ⊤) Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hderk : ∀ (l : Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (r : k), der l (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)) = 0)
    (hderx : ∀ l r : Fin m ⊕ Fin n,
      der l (coord (MvPolynomial.X r)) = if l = r then 1 else 0)
    (derW : Fin m → Derivation ℤ Γ(N, ⊤) Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hderWk : ∀ (l : Fin m) (r : k), derW l (w (MvPolynomial.C r)) = 0)
    (hderWw : ∀ l r : Fin m, derW l (w (MvPolynomial.X r)) = if l = r then 1 else 0)
    (equations : Fin n → Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hequations : RingHom.ker j.appTop.hom = Ideal.span (Set.range equations))
    (hjacobian : ∀ b : N, IsUnit (Matrix.det (fun l r : Fin n ↦
      N.Γevaluation b (j.appTop (der (Sum.inr r) (equations l))))))
    (TN : ∀ b : N, Γ(N, ⊤) →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) (N.residueField b))
    (hTN : ∀ b : N, isTaylorMap w (N.Γevaluation b).hom (TN b))
    (straight : ∀ b : N, Γ(U, ⊤) →+*
      MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (N.residueField b))
    (hres : ∀ (b : N) (r : Γ(U, ⊤)),
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (straight b r) = N.Γevaluation b (j.appTop r))
    (hk : ∀ (b : N) (r : k), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (N.Γevaluation b (j.appTop (coord (MvPolynomial.C r)))))
    (hW : ∀ (b : N) (l : Fin m), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl l))) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (N.Γevaluation b (w (MvPolynomial.X l))) +
        MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inl l))
    (hZ : ∀ (b : N) (l : Fin n), straight b (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr l))) =
      MvPowerSeries.rename Sum.inl (TN b (j.appTop (coord (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr l))))) +
        MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr l))
    (α : Fin s → Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    (coeff : Fin s → (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hcenter : ∀ (l : Fin s) (γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ), γ.degree < (α l).degree →
      N.presheaf.germ ⊤ b₀ (by trivial) (coeff l γ) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (N.presheaf.stalk b₀) ^ ((α l).degree - γ.degree))
    (J : Ideal Γ(U, ⊤))
    (hJ : Ideal.map (straight b₀) J =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun l : Fin n ↦
        (MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr l) :
          MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) (N.residueField b₀))) ⊔
      Ideal.span {g | ∃ (l : Fin s) (γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (δ : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
        γ.degree < (α l).degree ∧ δ.degree < (α l).degree - γ.degree ∧
          g = MvPowerSeries.rename Sum.inl (iteratedPartial δ (TN b₀ (coeff l γ)))}) :
    ∃ V : U.Opens, j b₀ ∈ V ∧
      (∀ y : U, y ∈ V →
        ((∃ b : N, j b = y ∧ ∀ (l : Fin s) (γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ),
          γ.degree < (α l).degree →
            N.presheaf.germ ⊤ b (by trivial) (coeff l γ) ∈
              IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (N.presheaf.stalk b) ^ ((α l).degree - γ.degree)) ↔
          J ≤ RingHom.ker (U.Γevaluation y).hom)) ∧
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop J).comap V.ι =
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (Ideal.comap j.appTop.hom
          (Ideal.span {h | ∃ (l : Fin s) (γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (δ : Fin m →₀ ℕ),
            γ.degree < (α l).degree ∧ δ.degree < (α l).degree - γ.degree ∧
              h = regularIteratedPartial derW δ (coeff l γ)}))).comap V.ι
